Kestin2025.title: AI tutoring outperforms in-class active learning: an RCT introducing a novel research-based design in an authentic educational setting

Liu2026.title: AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance
Liu2026.design: randomized controlled trials, total N=1,222 per authors
Liu2026.boundary: brief math/reading interactions; preprint and not long-horizon professional deskilling evidence

MTO.title: The Effects of Exposure to Better Neighborhoods on Children
MTO.design: randomized housing voucher experiment with long-run administrative outcomes
MTO.boundary: specific childhood neighborhood intervention; not a universal environment mechanism

CunhaHeckman2007.title: The Technology of Skill Formation
CunhaHeckman2007.boundary: human development model; not a universal Actor update equation
